zh.text: $KYMR Kymera Therapeutics- 我繼續發現許多醫療保健股票目前比許多科技股更具吸引力。醫療保健子行業正在發生漂亮的長期基底突破。雖然我預期科技股可以帶領下週反彈，但仍有一些障礙需要克服。選舉可以成為減少黨派之爭的正面力量，但如果利率尚未正式見頂，它們並不是許多人預期的市場清除事件。

en.text: $KYMR Kymera Therapeutics- I continue to find many HC stocks far more attractive than many within Tech these days. Beautiful long-term base breakouts are happening across sub-sectors within Healthcare. While I do anticipate Tech can lead the bounce into next week, it's got some wood to chop. Elections can be a positive force for Partisanship lessening, but they're not the market clearing event many expect if Rates haven't officially peaked yet.

zh.text: 不。德國的TARGET2債權基本上是高債務外圍國家人為債息上限及貨幣大幅高估的對應物。這無法輕算消。若沒有這些債權，外圍貨幣已經大幅貶值，當然它們有一天仍可能這樣做…

en.text: No. Germany’s TARGET2 claims are basically the counterpart to artificial yield caps and big currency overvaluations on the high-debt periphery. There is no netting this out. Without these claims, periphery currencies would have devalued massively and of course they still might one day…

zh.text: 一個76年零失誤的統計即將啟動。自1950年以來，標普500在每次中期選舉後12個月都更高。19次中的19次。平均漲幅約16%。即使如2018年等糟糕年份，接下來12個月仍上漲。中期年低點通常在選舉前出現。不確定性清除後資金迴流。觀察NVDA高於212，MU回到900以上，SNDK回到1200以上，NBIS回到170以上，AMD回到500以上。SMH守住525，QQQ高於700，SPX高於7630。若守住則推高；否則SPX向7300，QQQ向660。整體未來12個月應更高。

en.text: A 76-year stat with zero misses is about to kick in. Since 1950 the S&P 500 has been higher 12 months after every single midterm election. 19 for 19. Average gain about 16%. Even ugly years like 2018 still finished next 12 months up. Midterm year lows usually print before the election. Uncertainty clears and money floods back. Watching $NVDA above 212, $MU back above 900, $SNDK back above 1200, $NBIS back above 170, $AMD back above 500. $SMH holding 525 with $QQQ above 700 and $SPX above 7630. If hold, push higher; if not, SPX towards 7300 and QQQ towards 660. Overall next 12 months should be higher.

zh.text: 星期三交易計劃：$AMD 在財報後跳空高開，並帶動半導體和 AI 股票在盤後上漲。中期選舉今晚舉行；過去 19 次中期選舉後股市 12 個月表現均為正。在每個行業中尋找最佳公司，並在未來 2-3 週開始買入，至少持有 6-9 個月。期待 QQQ 在週五收盤高於 700，以及 $SPX 高於 7620。$NBIS 有機會達到 170，$MU 達到 900，$SNDK 達到 1250 有可能，如果 $SMH 本週能守住 525 上方，下週可看到 550。

en.text: Trade plan for Wednesday: $AMD gapping higher after earnings and lifting semiconductor and AI stocks after hours. Midterm elections tonight; the 12-month performance of the stock market after midterms has been positive the past 19 elections. Find the best companies in each sector and start buying over the next 2-3 weeks and hold for at least 6-9 months. Looking for QQQ to close above 700 and $SPX above 7620 by Friday. $NBIS to 170 in play, $MU to 900, $SNDK to 1250 possible, if $SMH can hold above 525 this week we can see 550 next week.
